stages.name: dyad
stages.claim: agent i hears neighbour j; their discrepancy is d_e = x_j - x_i^-

stages.name: kernel
stages.claim: the kernel k turns the distance |d_e| into a gain

stages.name: density
stages.claim: the update is a noisy draw around k(d_e), a fraction of the way toward j

stages.name: outcome
stages.claim: we observe the outcome: x_i^+ = x_i^- + delta_e
